inputs.name: pihole_version
inputs.description: Tag of the docker.io/pihole/pihole image, such as "2026.10.0". Each tag pins Pi-hole's core, web interface and FTL together.

inputs.name: web_password
inputs.description: Password for the web interface and the API. It reaches the host in a root-only file and never the plan or state.

inputs.name: upstream_dns
inputs.description: DNS servers Pi-hole forwards allowed queries to, as addresses, optionally with #port, such as ["192.168.1.1", "127.0.0.1#5335"]. The default is Quad9.

inputs.name: listening_mode
inputs.description: Which queries Pi-hole answers: LOCAL (devices on the host's own subnets), SINGLE (only those arriving on interface), BIND (binds to interface only), ALL (anyone who can reach port 53) or NONE.

inputs.name: interface
inputs.description: Network interface for SINGLE and BIND, such as "eth0". When null, Pi-hole picks the interface of the default route.

inputs.name: blocklists
inputs.description: Blocklist URLs to add next to Pi-hole's default list, such as ["https://big.oisd.nl"].

inputs.name: local_dns_records
inputs.description: Local DNS records, names to IP addresses, such as { "nas.home.arpa" = "192.168.1.20" }.

inputs.name: web_port
inputs.description: Where the web interface listens, in Pi-hole's webserver.port syntax, such as "8080" or "127.0.0.1:8080". When null, Pi-hole's default: 80 and 443 with a self-signed certificate.
